newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lead says UES to issue at least $200 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Lead says UES to issue at least $200 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Moscow-based investment bank Renaissance Capital and Germany's Deutsche Bank's investment arm Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were awarded a mandate to lead-manage Russia's Unified Energy System (UES) Eurobond, Renaissance said on Thursday.
UES will make its debut Eurobond issue of at least $200 million, Renaissance said in a statement.

Renaissance Capital and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will extend UES a $200 million unbacked credit, as well as serve as advisers to UES as it applies for credit ratings from Moody's and Standard & Poor's, Renaissance said in a statement.
UES, Russia's largest company by assets, also plans to issue five trillion roubles (about $1 billion) of convertible bonds to raise funds to pay off overdue taxes.
Renaissance said UES would soon hold a tender to choose an adviser for the issue, which would cover 5.4 percent of UES capital.
